result.title: MathVis: Can AI Reason through Drawing? A Benchmark for Mathematical Figure Generation
result.summary: This paper introduces MathVis, a benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to visualize frontier mathematical problems and perform diagram-assisted reasoning. The benchmark consists of 512 tasks, each comprising a mathematical statement, a reference diagram, executable TikZ or SVG code, a Gold Intermediate Representation (IR), atomic rubrics, and error codes. Through rigorous evaluation, GPT-6-Astra, Claude Fable 5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview achieve pass@1 scores of 31.25%, 26.56%, and 22.85%, respectively. We found that although the tasks require visualization, LLMs produce outputs dominated by formal languages, symbols, and graphics programs, rather than explicit diagram-mediated reasoning. Furthermore, while the solutions generated by LLMs may contain all the necessary elements, they are often visually confusing to humans. Ultimately, this benchmark aims to visualize mathematical problems and promote research on enabling LLMs to simplify their reasoning via visual diagrams.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MathVis 基准，包含 512 个需为前沿数学问题生成图形并借助图示推理的任务，配有参考图、TikZ/SVG 代码、Gold IR 与评分标准；评测发现即使强模型也主要输出形式语言与图形程序，而非真正的图示中介推理，且图示对人类常难以辨认。
AI.relevance_reason: 该基准诊断了模型「看似可视化、实则依赖符号输出」的现象，与「视觉证据是否真正参与推理」这一问题有具体关联；但其衡量的是外部图形生成质量，不涉及内部状态的保留、使用与贡献分配，可作为对照线索核查。
